blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five V183 views and six pose renders shows pronounced folded/faceted overskirt panels in neutral and posed views. Crouch lifts the skirt above the fitted shorts across the front, and sit bunches the skirt behind the pelvis while both shorts and upper thighs remain broadly exposed. The declared thigh-surface placement did not resolve pose coverage or garment drape. This is prototype render evidence only and does not establish fit.

Gray body-colored patches and abrupt hard facets remain visible across the ivory chest and waist in the front, three-quarter, arm-cross, crouch, and sit renders. Their origin is not established by these renders; visible bodice surface quality remains unacceptable.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
